title: item name deobfuscator
description: Mod that allows you to reveal magic (k formatted) text in item names in inventory/chat/hotbar
body:
# Antimagic
Simple mod to deobfuscate magic (k) text in item names in hotbar, inventory and chat.

## Usage
Just hover and hold alt if in chat or inventory, or in hotbar just hold alt!

powered by hopes and dreams
